name: Barbell Drag Curl
steps: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart and grip a barbell shoulder-width apart in front of your thighs with palms facing forward.
Brace your core and keep your chest upright.
Pull your elbows straight backward as you drag the bar upward along the front of your torso toward your lower chest.
Lower the bar slowly back down along your body until your arms extend fully.
tips: Let the bar skim gently up your torso without leaning backward.
Drive your elbows behind your ribs rather than letting them swing forward like a standard curl.
